title: Blog and wiki can name related pages
description:
**As an** editor, **I want** frontmatter for related wiki slugs on posts and related posts on wiki pages, **so that** the eventual blog-wiki web can be filled without another schema change.

Observable later; for this pass prove it with unit tests of the loaders: relatedWiki on a post, relatedPosts on a wiki page, missing targets omitted.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Loaders resolve relatedPosts and relatedWiki; missing and draft targets are omitted. RelatedLinksSection renders nothing when empty.
